---
title: "TidyTuesday Projects" 
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(htmltools)

tidytuesday_page <- div(
  class = "project-container",
  
  # TidyTuesday Description
  div(
    class = "tidytuesday-intro",
    p(
      a(
        href = "https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday",
        target = "_blank",
        strong("TidyTuesday")
      ),
      " is a weekly data project. Every week, a new dataset is released, ",
      "and participants create visualizations, analyses, and applications to explore the data. "
    ),
    p(
      "Below are my contributions to the TidyTuesday challenge"
    )
  ),
  
  # Projects Section
  div(
    class = "tidytuesday-projects",
    
    # Week 47 - Statistical Performance Indicators
    div(
      class = "tt-project-card",
      div(
        class = "tt-header",
        h2("Statistical Performance Indicators"),
        h3("Week 47 - November 25, 2024")
      ),
      div(
        class = "tt-subtitle",
        p("World Bank Statistical Performance Indicators - Measuring the Statistical Performance of Countries")
      ),
      div(
        class = "tt-content",
        div(
          class = "tt-image-container",
          a(
            href = "https://jpdonadio.shinyapps.io/Statistical_Indicators_tidytuesday47/",
            target = "_blank",
            img(
              src = "images/tt_week47_preview.png",
              alt = "Statistical Performance Indicators Shiny App Preview",
              class = "tt-preview-image"
            ),
            div(
              class = "tt-overlay",
              p("Click to launch interactive Shiny app")
            )
          )
        ),
        div(
          class = "tt-tech",
          strong("Type: "), "Interactive Shiny Application",
          br(),
          strong("Technologies: "), 
          span(class = "tech-tag", "R"),
          span(class = "tech-tag", "Shiny"),
          span(class = "tech-tag", "World Bank Data"),
          span(class = "tech-tag", "Interactive Visualization")
        )
      )
    ),
    
    # Week 48 - Snowman Prediction
    div(
      class = "tt-project-card",
      div(
        class = "tt-header",
        h2("Can an Exploding Snowman Predict the Summer Season?"),
        h3("Week 48 - December 2, 2024")
      ),
      div(
        class = "tt-subtitle",
        p("OpenData for Zurich's Sechseläuten - Böögg Prediction")
      ),
      div(
        class = "tt-content",
        div(
          class = "tt-image-container",
          a(
            href = "https://jpdonadio.shinyapps.io/Snowman_prediction_tt48/",
            target = "_blank",
            img(
              src = "images/tt_week48_preview.png",
              alt = "Snowman Prediction Shiny App Preview",
              class = "tt-preview-image"
            ),
            div(
              class = "tt-overlay",
              p("Click to launch interactive Shiny app")
            )
          )
        ),
        div(
          class = "tt-tech",
          strong("Type: "), "Interactive Shiny Application",
          br(),
          strong("Technologies: "), 
          span(class = "tech-tag", "R"),
          span(class = "tech-tag", "Shiny"),
          span(class = "tech-tag", "Predictive Analysis"),
          span(class = "tech-tag", "Swiss Open Data")
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  
  # Footer Note
  div(
    class = "tidytuesday-footer",
    p(
      "Interested in participating? Visit the ",
      a(
        href = "https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday",
        target = "_blank",
        "TidyTuesday GitHub repository"
      ),
      " to see current and past datasets."
    )
  )
)

tidytuesday_page
```
